How do you plan an AI micro drama?

Start with one character, a clear goal and a visible change. Build a short scene plan before generating clips, then review identity, costume, screen direction, dialogue and sound across the whole sequence.

Can a film be delivered in more than one ratio?

Plan composition for each agreed placement before production. A vertical reel and a cinematic landscape film may need different framing; preserve the full subject instead of stretching or blindly cropping the same export.
